Your trust means everything to us.

To ensure you receive accurate, authentic, and verified job updates, please note that Daily Jobs Goa is officially available only on the following platforms:

🌐 Official Website
📸 Official Instagram Page
👍 Official Facebook Page
💬 Official WhatsApp Channel

Our official logo is displayed consistently across all these platforms to help you identify our genuine accounts.

We have noticed that some social media pages are reposting our job posters and carousel posts, including content containing our watermark. While public content may be shared by others, such pages are not affiliated with or managed by Daily Jobs Goa unless they are one of our official platforms.

People's High School, Mala, Panaji, Goa, invites applications from eligible candidates for various Teaching and Non-Teaching posts on a PERMANENT BASIS.

🔹 Teaching Posts:
• Trained Undergraduate Teacher – Science & Mathematics
• Trained Undergraduate Teacher – Hindi
• Trained Undergraduate Teacher – Sanskrit & Marathi
• Trained Undergraduate Teacher – Marathi
• Trained Undergraduate Teacher – English & Social Science

🔹 Non-Teaching Posts:
• Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)
• Lower Division Clerk (LDC)
• LDC cum Librarian

• TET clearance is mandatory for teaching posts.
• Male candidates may also apply.
• Applications can be submitted through hand delivery or email.
• Attach Employment Card Registration, Residence Certificate and Academic Qualification Certificates.

📧 Email: peopleshigh@peoplesschool.edu.in

📅 Last Date to Apply: 13th November 2026

📍 Location: Mala, Panaji, Goa
